# HMPFL Week 8: Lockdown Recap

The cellblock saw some chaos this week — a nail-biter escape, a full-blown prison riot of points, and one unfortunate soul who dropped 274 points and still got sent to solitary.

## Closest Call: Stay of Execution

In a photo finish that had the warden reviewing the tape, **Glove Don't Fit, Blitz** narrowly survived **Hernandez Hitmen**, 198.1 to 197.4. That's a 0.7-point margin — closer than the space between bunk beds in general population. Hernandez Hitmen can appeal all they want, but the verdict stands.

## Biggest Blowout: Maximum Security Beatdown

**DUIiiiiiiii dont know jim** put up a jaw-dropping 319.3 points to demolish **The ConVicks** by 45.1. Here's the kicker — The ConVicks dropped 274.2 points, a total that wins most weeks in this league, and still got thrown in the hole. Patrick Mahomes went off for 62.8 points for The ConVicks and it still wasn't enough. Tough break, fellas — sometimes the house always wins.

## Star of the Week: Joey B's Jailbreak

Nobody had a bigger night than **Joe Burrow**, who torched the league for 85.2 points in **Steve Ruggs'** lineup. Unfortunately, Steve Ruggs still lost by 32.95 to **Smack my Diggs up**, proving that in HMPFL, even a Hall of Fame outing from your QB can't bail out a sinking ship if the rest of your roster is on lockdown.

## Other Notables

**DUIiiiiiiii dont know jim** didn't just win big, they went full gang-up mode — Tee Higgins (60.0), Bhayshul Tuten (57.8), and Jahmyr Gibbs (52.1) all popped off in the same lineup, giving them three players in the top 10 performances of the week. That's not a fantasy team, that's a crime syndicate.

Meanwhile, **OJ's Denver Bronco** stayed hot, riding Tyler Allgeier's 70.2-point explosion and Tony Pollard's 51.9 to a 40-point blowout over Ruggs, Drugs and TDs. OJ's squad is starting to look like the team nobody wants smoke with.

Stay vigilant out there, inmates — Week 9 is right around the corner, and the yard is only getting more dangerous.
